situations.situation: You are going to attend an important interview and your vehicle breaks down on a lonely road. You have only 40 minutes.
While travelling by train at night you see a co-passenger being harassed by a group of men.
You are leading a trekking group and one member twists an ankle badly, far from the base camp.
You discover your close friend copying in an examination you are invigilating.
On the way to the railway station you find a wallet with a large amount of cash and an ID card.
You are the captain of the team and your best player refuses to follow your instructions before a final match.
Your village is cut off by a flood and food stocks are running low. You are the only one with some organising experience.
A fire breaks out in the neighbouring house when the family is out and you are alone at home.
You are at the bank when armed robbers enter and take everyone hostage.
Your team has been given a project with a deadline of two days, but two members have fallen ill.
You find a classmate crying alone because he failed an important examination.
During a night camp you hear strange noises near the tents and some members are scared.
You are going for an interview and see a road accident in which a man is badly injured.
Your close friend asks you to help him get out of a college rule violation by lying to the principal.
You are in charge of a college fest and the chief guest cancels at the last minute.
While swimming at a river, you notice a child being swept away from the bank.
Your younger brother is addicted to mobile games and is failing in school.
You are the group leader and two members are quarrelling over the task division, delaying the work.
You were promised a leave for your sister's wedding, but your boss asks you to stay for an urgent task.
While on a cycle trip you reach a bridge that is broken and it is getting dark.
You find that one of your teammates has been spreading false rumours about you.
You are alone at home when an unknown person claiming to be an electricity officer insists on coming in.
You are given charge of a junior group but they do not take you seriously because you are young.
You are in a lift with others and it stops between floors and the lights go out.
Your friend is depressed after a breakup and has stopped talking to everyone.
Your family is facing a financial crisis and you get a job offer that would prevent you from studying further.
A stranger in the market starts abusing you without any reason.
In your hostel you notice a student secretly bringing in alcohol.
You are in a crowded bus and notice a pickpocket stealing from an old man.
You are climbing a mountain with a team and a sudden snowstorm begins.
The college principal blames you wrongly for damage to college property.
Your teacher gives you a very difficult assignment to complete in one day and you know you don't have the full knowledge.
There is an outbreak of disease in your area and many people ignore precautions.
You see a group of boys ragging a junior student in your college.
You have to lead a night patrol and one of your members refuses to go because he is afraid.
While on duty you find that a senior has made a mistake that may cause loss to the organisation.
You are given a task you have never done before and the person who could guide you is on leave.
A fellow student seeks your notes before the exam but you know he never helps others.
You are returning home late at night and find a street dog badly hurt by a vehicle.
Your friend invites you to a party the night before your most important exam.
In a team event your rival group is clearly ahead and your team has begun to lose hope.
